LOADING: E tohu ana i te papa…
MENU_QUICK_DESC: Ko ētahi whenua e rua, ko tētahi wāhi. Nāu te tuku waenga.
MENU_CUP_DESC: E waru whenua, e rua rōpū, whiringa whāiti, whiringa toa.
MENU_CUP_CONTINUE: Kei te haere tonu tō ipu. Kia haere tonu.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Te papa, ngā tūranga e whitu me ngā ture katoa a ngā kaiwawao.
QUARTERS_NOTE: E whā ngā hauwhā o te tukinga tūturu, 15 meneti ia. Ka rere tonu te karaka i ngā piro, ka tū anake mō te whara.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: He ture rīki: i ngā meneti whakamutunga e rima o ia hauwhā, e rua ngā piro mō te piro mai i te 3 m neke atu.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: He pōturi ō rātou kaiārai ki te pānui i ō tuku, he onge te haukoti.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: He kapa karapu pai: ka kapohia e rātou te tuku tūtakarerewa.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: He kapa ā-ao: he tere ki te pānui i te tākaro, he uaua ki te tuku huri noa.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Ko te hunga pai rawa o te ao. Ka haukotia ia tuku māngere.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: Ko koe te tangata kei a ia te pōro, me te kaiārai e tata ana ki reira.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Kapa: ka whakahaere koe i te tangata kei a ia te pōro. Kotahi tūranga: kōwhiria he kahu i te mata kāinga, tākaro ai ko ia mō te tukinga katoa.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: Kā: ka tū tō kaitākaro ki te taha o ngā wāhi e āhei ana tōna tūranga. Weto: ka whiti koe i te rārangi, ka karanga te kaiwawao i te wāhi hē.
POS_ROLE_GS: Ka piro mai i te taha tata o te pou.
POS_ROLE_GA: Ka piro, ka whāngai i te kaipupuhi, ka kōkiri mā te hautoru waenga.
POS_ROLE_WA: Ka whāngai i te porowhita mai i tōna taha; te kōwhiringa tuatahi i te tuku waenga.
POS_ROLE_C: Ka tango i te tuku waenga, ka hono i te ārai ki te whakaeke puta noa i te papa.
POS_ROLE_WD: Ka kati i te Wing Attack, ka aukati i te whāngai ki te porowhita.
POS_ROLE_GD: Ka kati i te Goal Attack, i roto, i waho hoki i te porowhita.
POS_ROLE_GK: Ka kati i te Goal Shooter, ka ārai i te pupuhi, ka kapo i te pōro hoki mai.
POS_AREAS_GS: Ngā wāhi: te hautoru whakaeke me te porowhita piro.
POS_AREAS_GA: Ngā wāhi: te hautoru waenga, te hautoru whakaeke me te porowhita piro.
POS_AREAS_WA: Ngā wāhi: te hautoru waenga me te hautoru whakaeke, kāore i te porowhita.
POS_AREAS_C: Ngā wāhi: ngā hautoru e toru, kāore i ngā porowhita.
POS_AREAS_WD: Ngā wāhi: te hautoru waenga me te hautoru ārai, kāore i te porowhita.
POS_AREAS_GD: Ngā wāhi: te hautoru waenga, te hautoru ārai me te porowhita piro.
POS_AREAS_GK: Ngā wāhi: te hautoru ārai me te porowhita piro.
GFX_NOTE: E pai ana te Iti mō ngā waea utu iti: kāore he rārangi taha, he iti ake te mano. Mēnā kā te Aunoa, ka heke iho tētahi taumata mēnā he pōturi te tukinga i ōna hēkona tuatahi.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Tata ki te {n} anga ia hēkona, he iti iho te rahi: he mātao ake, he roa ake te pūhiko.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: {n} anga ia hēkona i tō mata {hz} Hz: he māeneene, he atawhai ake ki te pūhiko i te mōrahi.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Ngā anga katoa e taea ana e tō mata {hz} Hz.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Tōia ia pātene ki te wāhi e kitea ai e tō kōnui. Ka noho tonu ki reira.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: He kēmu motuhake tēnei. Ko ngā kapa he whenua i ō rātou ingoa noa; he mea hanga ngā ingoa katoa o ngā kaitākaro. Kāore e hono ana ki tētahi rōpū whakahaere, rīki, whakataetae rānei.
LICENCES_INTRO: I hangaia te kēmu ki te pūmanawa kore utu, tuwhera hoki. E tono ana ōna raihana kia whakaaturia ēnei pānui; kei te reo Pākehā, pērā i tā rātou i tuhi ai.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: 30.5 m te roa, 15.25 m te whānui, e toru ngā hautoru. He porowhita waenga 0.9 m te whānui kei waenganui, ā, kei ia pito he porowhita piro: he hāwhe porowhita 4.9 m mai i te pou. 3.05 m te teitei o te mowhiti, kāore he papa tuarā.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Ka mau ia kaitākaro i tētahi kahu e tohu ana i tōna tūranga, ka uru anake ki ngā wāhi o tōna tūranga. Tae atu ki te tekau mā rua ka whakaingoatia e te kapa; ka whakarerekē i ngā wā okioki, i muri i te piro mēnā ka tonoa, mō te whara hoki.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: Ko te Goal Shooter me te Goal Attack anake e piro ana, ā, mai i roto anake i te porowhita piro. Me puta te pōro mā roto katoa i te mowhiti. Ka tatauria te pupuhi mēnā i wehe i ōna ringa i mua i te whio.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Ka tīmata ia hauwhā ki te tuku waenga, me te tākaro i muri i ia piro. Ka huri whakawhiti, ahakoa ko wai i piro. Ka tū te Centre ki te porowhita waenga; ka tatari ētahi atu ki ō rātou hautoru piro tae noa ki te whio, ā, me hopu te tuku i te hautoru waenga.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: E whā ngā hauwhā, 15 meneti ia, e whā meneti i waenga i te tuatahi me te tuarua, i te tuatoru me te tuawhā, tekau mā rua i te haurua. Ka huri ngā kapa i ngā pito i ia hauwhā.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: Ina me whai toa te tukinga, ā, he ōrite: e rua ngā haurua tae atu ki te whitu meneti, kotahi meneti i waenga, kātahi ka haere tonu te tākaro kia rua piro te kapa i mua.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: Kei a ia te pōro, kāore e taea te oma. Ko te waewae ka tau tuatahi tōna waewae tau: ka taea te hīkoi ki tērā atu, te huri hoki i runga i te waewae tau, engari ka hikitia, me tuku, me pupuhi rānei i mua i tōna pānga anō ki te papa. He tuku noa ki tērā kapa.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: Me tuku, me pupuhi rānei ia i roto i ngā hēkona e toru i muri i te hopu. Pōro pupuri: he tuku noa.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Ko te kaiārai e ngana ana ki te ārai, ki te tango rānei i te pōro me tū 0.9 m neke atu i te waewae tau o te kaipupuri. Ki te tata ake, he whakararu: he tuku whiu.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: Kāore he pā e whakararu ana i te tākaro a te hoariri: te pana, te pupuri, te pato i te pōro i ōna ringa, te kore whakawātea rānei i te kaitākaro kua riro te pōro kia tau ia. He tuku whiu.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Ko te kaitākaro ka hīkoi ki tētahi wāhi kāore e āhei ana tōna tūranga, kei a ia te pōro, kāore rānei, kei te wāhi hē. Ko ngā rārangi he wāhanga o ngā wāhi e karapotia ana. He tuku noa.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: Kāore e taea te whiu i te pōro ki tua o tētahi hautoru katoa ki te kore he kaitākaro i taua hautoru e hopu, e pā rānei. He tuku noa.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Me whai wāhi te hoariri ki te haukoti i waenga i te kaiwhiu me te kaihopu. He tuku noa.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Ko te pōro ka tau ki waho o te papa ka riro i te kapa kāore i pā whakamutunga: he panga mai i te wāhi i whiti ai i te rārangi, i roto i ngā hēkona e toru.
RULES_PENALTIES: Tuku noa me te tuku whiu
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: Ka tukuna te tuku noa i te wāhi o te hē, e tētahi kaitākaro e āhei ana ki reira. Mō te tuku whiu, ka tū te kaitākaro i whiua ki te taha o te kaiwhiu, kei waho o te tākaro, kia tukuna rā anō te pōro. I te porowhita piro, he tuku, he pupuhi rānei te whiu.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: Ka tukua e te kaiwawao kia haere tonu te tākaro ki te mea ka whara te kapa i hēngia mēnā ka aukatia: hei tauira, he kaipupuhi e tata ana ki te pupuhi. Ka karanga ia i te painga me te hē.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Mō te tākaro hē auau, mōrearea rānei, ka taea e te kaiwawao te whakatūpato, te whakatārewa mō ngā meneti tākaro e rua, te pana atu rānei. Mai i te 2024 kāore he panga ake: ina hē tahi ngā kaitākaro tokorua, ka mau tonu te kapa i a ia te pōro whakamutunga.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: He rerekē ngā ture o ētahi rīki. Kei tēnei kēmu te Rohe Rearua: i ngā meneti whakamutunga e rima o ia hauwhā, e rua ngā piro mō te piro mai i te 3 m neke atu i te pou.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Ko te kōnui mauī ki hea rānei i te taha mauī o te mata he rākau whakahaere: ka oma tō kaitākaro (te mowhiti kākāriki). Kōkiri ki te wāhi wātea kia wātea koe mō te tuku.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Kei a ia te pōro, kāore e taea te oma. Pana te rākau ki tētahi hoa kia kōwhiria ia (ka kitea he mowhiti), kātahi ka TUKU mō te tuku uma, pokohiwi rānei, TEITEI rānei kia rere ki runga ake i te kaiārai. Ko te mowhiti ki runga i te pōro ō hēkona e toru.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: Ka puta te PUPUHI ina kei tō Goal Shooter, Goal Attack rānei te pōro i te porowhita. Ka tata, ka tino; mā te ringa o te kaiārai ki runga i te pōro ka uaua ake.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: Mā te ĀRAI ka hiki ō ringa ki runga i te pōro. Titiro ki te mowhiti huri noa i tōna waewae tau: kākāriki he tika, whero he tata ake i te 0.9 m, ka karanga te kaiwawao i te whakararu.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: Ka peke te HAUKOTI ki te tuku i te rangi mēnā ka taea e koe i te wā tika. Mēnā ka rere atu koe ki te kaitākaro e pupuri ana i te pōro, he pā tinana tērā.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Ina tākaro koe hei kapa, ka whakahaere koe i te tangata kei a ia te pōro, ā, mā te HURI ka neke koe ki te kaiārai tata rawa. Kōwhiria he kahu tūranga i te mata kāinga kia kotahi tūranga mō te tukinga katoa.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD, ngā pere rānei hei neke, Space mō te pātene tuatahi, J me K mō ērā atu, Esc hei tatari.
INTERVAL_NOTE: E {min} meneti te wā okioki; mā te Haere tonu ka tīmata a {next} ināianei.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Pāwhiria he tūranga kia uru mai te kaitākaro tūru e whai ake ana mō taua tūranga.
CUP_ABOUT: E waru ngā whenua e tata ana ki tōu i te rārangi o te ao, i ngā rōpū e rua, tokowhā ia rōpū. Ka eke ngā mea tuatahi e rua o ia rōpū ki ngā whiringa whāiti; kātahi ko te whiringa toa me te tukinga parahi. E rua ngā kaute mō te toa, kotahi mō te ōrite; ka wehewehea ngā ōrite mā te ōrau piro.
CUP_OUT: Kua taka koe. Ka haere tonu te ipu me te kore koe.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Tākarohia he tukinga, ka tīmata ō rekoata ki konei.
REC_TOP_SHOOTER: Ngā piro maha rawa i te tukinga
REC_CUPS: Ipu o ngā Whenua kua riro
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: He ture rīki: e rua ngā wā okioki 90 hēkona mō ia kapa ia haurua, i muri i te piro. Kei te rārangi tatari tōu.
ROLLING_NOTE: He ture rīki: whakarerekēhia te kapa i ngā wā katoa mai i te rārangi tatari, ehara i ngā wā okioki anake.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: 90 hēkona, kua tū te karaka. Whakarerekēhia te kapa ināianei; Haere tonu ina rite koe.
INJURY_NOTE: Kua whara tētahi kaitākaro o {team}. E 30 hēkona te kapa hei āwhina i a ia ki waho; ka taea e ngā kapa e rua te whakarerekē. Haere tonu ina rite koe.
